scholz.title: Scholz Living Room & Trim Remodel
scholz.lead: Floor protection, drywall surface scraping, laser alignment before corner bead float, joint compounding, high-build primer, and trim restoration.

slides.title: Living Room Preparation & Floor Masking
slides.caption: Floor protection, laser leveling, and drywall surface scraping.

slides.title: Joint Compound & Corner Bead Float
slides.caption: Precision corner bead floating and multi-coat feathered compounding.

slides.title: Ceiling Blend & Dustless Sanding
slides.caption: Dustless drywall sanding and smooth ceiling transition blending.

slides.title: High-Build PVA Primer Application
slides.caption: Uniform high-build PVA primer coat sealing patched gypsum boards.

slides.title: Enamel Window & Door Trim Casing
slides.caption: Ultra-smooth satin urethane enamel coating on custom trim moldings.

slides.title: Completed Architectural Trim
slides.caption: Pristine level-5 drywall finish and seamless interior architectural trim.

siding.title: Two-Story Slate Blue Siding & Architectural Gables
siding.lead: Full tear-off down to original sheathing, foil-faced thermal barrier installation, slate-blue vinyl lap siding, and white architectural gable accents.

slides.title: Finished Slate Blue Siding
slides.caption: Completed high-durability siding with crisp architectural white corner posts.

slides.title: Gable Detail & Soffit Wrap
slides.caption: Vented vinyl soffit integration and aluminum fascia trim wraps.

slides.title: Weather Barrier & Sheathing
slides.caption: Vapor barrier flashing around window heads and precision sill pans.

decks.title: Custom Composite Deck & Treated Substructure
decks.lead: Treated timber framing, below-frost concrete sonotube piers, and premium composite decking with hidden clip fasteners and custom stair assemblies.

slides.title: Finished Composite Surface
slides.caption: Maintenance-free composite deck boards fastened with hidden clip systems.

slides.title: Heavy Timber Substructure
slides.caption: Treated 2x10 joist framing and galvanized structural post-beam connectors.

slides.title: Covered Porch Ceiling
slides.caption: Tongue-and-groove natural pine ceiling under covered patio deck.

windows.title: Replacement Windows & Insulated Entry Doors
windows.lead: Energy-efficient Low-E Argon vinyl and composite replacement windows with expanding foam thermal break seals and custom aluminum casing wraps.

slides.title: Low-E Argon Replacement Window
slides.caption: Low-pressure polyurethane foam insulation sealing window perimeter.

slides.title: Custom Aluminum Casing Wrap
slides.caption: Maintenance-free exterior aluminum trim bending and weather-tight silicone caulking.
